item.title: Nigeria boosts net forex reserves to $34.8bn in 2025 amid policy reforms
item.description: Nigeria’s foreign exchange reserves recorded a sharp rise at the end of 2025, with net reserves climbing to $34.80 billion, according to Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Governor Olayemi Cardoso.
